name: – Niclas Herbst – After § 131 – Am 79
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 131 a. Stresses that the EU's Migration and Asylum Pact is a failed attempt to implement large-scale reforms, it needs to be recognised that illegal migration has to be stopped before reaching the external borders and instead of migrant quotas there is need for an effective return and prevention of further illegal inflows, changes are necessary as regards the EU’s migration and asylum regulatory framework, including establishing a system for extraterritoriality, examining asylum applications outside the EU;
